description: This file defines the internal class SQSAdapterReceiver, which implements the IQueueAdapterReceiver interface for receiving message batches from an Amazon SQS queue within the Orleans framework. It includes methods for initializing, shutting down, retrieving messages, and confirming message delivery, utilizing AWS SDK and Orleans serialization.

classes.name: SQSAdapterReceiver
classes.description: Implements message reception from an Amazon SQS queue for Orleans streaming, managing message retrieval, acknowledgment, and lifecycle.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate an SQSAdapterReceiver with necessary dependencies and configuration.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the queue, preparing it for message retrieval.

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Gracefully shuts down the receiver, ensuring pending operations complete.

methods.name: GetQueueMessagesAsync
methods.description: Fetches a batch of messages from the queue asynchronously.

methods.name: MessagesDeliveredAsync
methods.description: Confirms delivery of messages and deletes them from the queue.
